"""
Project Title: Spatio-Temporal Graph Transformer Neural ODE for Traffic Forecasting (ai-ml-ds-GTNODE-Traffic2025)
File Name: gtnode_traffic_forecast.py

Short Description:
Integrates Graph Neural Networks (GNN), Neural ODEs, and Transformers into a unified Keras architecture to forecast traffic flow on a road network. Processes irregular timestamps, leverages spatial adjacency, continuous-time dynamics, and attention for multi-step prediction. Uses METR-LA dataset via tfds.
"""

import numpy as np  # type: ignore
import tensorflow as tf  # type: ignore
from tensorflow.keras import layers, Model, Input  # type: ignore
import tensorflow_datasets as tfds  # type: ignore

# Hyperparameters
NUM_NODES: int = 207
ODE_HIDDEN: int = 64
TRANS_HEADS: int = 4
TRANS_LAYERS: int = 3
MLP_DIM: int = 128
LR: float = 1e-3
BATCH: int = 16
EPOCHS: int = 50
HIST_STEPS: int = 12
PRED_STEPS: int = 12

# Adjacency
adj_matrix: tf.Tensor = tf.Variable(tf.random.uniform((NUM_NODES, NUM_NODES)), trainable=False)

# Neural-ODE GNN Cell
class GNNODECell(tf.keras.layers.Layer):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.dense = layers.Dense(ODE_HIDDEN, activation="relu")
    def call(self, t, h):
        neigh = tf.matmul(adj_matrix, h)
        return self.dense(tf.concat([h, neigh], axis=-1))

def ode_gnn_encode(x_hist: tf.Tensor, times: tf.Tensor) -> tf.Tensor:
    h = tf.zeros((tf.shape(x_hist)[0], NUM_NODES, ODE_HIDDEN))
    cell = GNNODECell()
    for i in range(HIST_STEPS - 1):
        dt = times[:, i+1:i+2] - times[:, i:i+1]
        for _ in range(3):
            h = h + dt[:,:,None] * cell(None, h)
        cur = x_hist[:, i]
        h = tf.concat([h, cur[:,:,None]], -1)
        h = layers.Dense(ODE_HIDDEN, activation="relu")(h)
    return h  # (batch, nodes, hidden)

# Transformer Decoder for forecasting per-node time-series
def build_transformer_decoder(num_nodes):
    inp = Input((PRED_STEPS, num_nodes, ODE_HIDDEN))
    x = inp
    x = layers.Reshape((PRED_STEPS, num_nodes * ODE_HIDDEN))(x)
    for _ in range(TRANS_LAYERS):
        x1 = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
        att = layers.MultiHeadAttention(TRANS_HEADS, num_nodes*ODE_HIDDEN//TRANS_HEADS)(x1, x1)
        x = x + att
        x2 = layers.LayerNormalization()(x)
        mlp = layers.Dense(MLP_DIM, activation="gelu")(x2)
        mlp = layers.Dense(num_nodes*ODE_HIDDEN)(mlp)
        x = x + mlp
    out = layers.Dense(NUM_NODES)(x)
    out = layers.Reshape((PRED_STEPS, NUM_NODES))(out)
    return Model(inp, out)

transformer = build_transformer_decoder(NUM_NODES)
optimizer = tf.keras.optimizers.Adam(LR)
mse = tf.keras.losses.MeanSquaredError()

# Data pipeline: METR-LA dataset
ds = tfds.load("metr_la", split="train", as_supervised=False)
def prep(sample):
    data = sample["speed"]  # shape (T, N)
    times = tf.linspace(0.,1., tf.shape(data)[0])
    xs = []
    ys = []
    for i in range(tf.shape(data)[0] - HIST_STEPS - PRED_STEPS):
        xs.append((data[i:i+HIST_STEPS], times[i:i+HIST_STEPS]))
        ys.append(data[i+HIST_STEPS:i+HIST_STEPS+PRED_STEPS])
    xs = tf.stack([x[0] for x in xs])
    ts = tf.stack([x[1] for x in xs])
    ys = tf.stack(ys)
    return xs, ts, ys

ds = ds.map(prep).unbatch().batch(BATCH)

# Training loop
@tf.function
def step(x_hist, times, y_true):
    with tf.GradientTape() as tape:
        h = ode_gnn_encode(x_hist, times)  # (B, N, H)
        h_tile = tf.tile(tf.expand_dims(h,1), [1,PRED_STEPS,1,1])
        y_pred = transformer(h_tile)
        loss = mse(y_true, y_pred)
    grads = tape.gradient(loss, transformer.trainable_variables)
    optimizer.apply_gradients(zip(grads, transformer.trainable_variables))
    return loss

for ep in range(1, EPOCHS+1):
    for x_hist, times, y in ds:
        loss = step(x_hist, times, y)
    tf.print("Epoch", ep, "Loss", loss)

# Example use case
sample = next(iter(ds))
x_hist, times, y = sample
h = ode_gnn_encode(x_hist, times)
pred = transformer(tf.tile(tf.expand_dims(h,1), [1,PRED_STEPS,1,1]))
print("True[0]:", y[0,0].numpy(), "Pred[0]:", pred[0,0].numpy())
